description: This file defines an Android activity named VideoPlayerActivity that demonstrates full-screen video playback with UI controls, including inner classes for UI content management and tab handling.

classes.name: VideoPlayerActivity
classes.description: Main activity for demonstrating full-screen video playback with system UI toggling, action bar tabs, and sharing features.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Inner class representing a custom ImageView that manages UI visibility flags, user interaction, and full-screen controls for video gameplay.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Content view with activity context, title view, play button, and seek bar, and sets up its click listener.

methods.name: setPlayPaused
methods.description: Toggles the play/pause state of the video, updates UI, and manages screen-on flag.

methods.name: setNavVisibility
methods.description: Controls the system UI flags to hide or show navigation and status bars.
